text: When I was young I mended printing presses, and nothing ever stayed mended. These days I break things in my own house, on purpose, and I keep careful notes about exactly how.

voices.us_warm: A cheerful American man of about seventy with a warm, dry, amused voice and a relaxed General American accent, medium pitch, clear and easy to understand, unhurried, like a retired mechanic telling a good story in a quiet room.
voices.us_raspy: A cheerful American man of about seventy with a slightly raspy, friendly, amused voice and a relaxed Midwestern American accent, medium pitch, easygoing and a little playful, like a retired mechanic telling a joke at a kitchen table.
voices.us_bright: A cheerful American man of about seventy with a bright, light, quick-witted voice and a casual East Coast American accent, medium-high pitch, animated and amused, like a friendly shopkeeper telling a story.
